UPSC GS-II Knowledge System

A structured and integrated knowledge resource for General Studies Paper II of the UPSC Civil Services Examination.

The system brings together constitutional provisions, institutional relationships, governance frameworks, judicial developments, social-sector issues and India's international relations.

GS-II Study Modules

Select a module to explore its chapters and build a connected understanding of the GS-II syllabus.

How to Use This Knowledge System

  • Study the chapters in the context of the relevant constitutional provisions, institutions and governance frameworks.
  • Connect related topics across modules instead of treating each subject as an isolated area.
  • Understand both factual details and the constitutional, institutional and analytical dimensions of each topic.
  • Use the chapter references, judgments, reports and examples to develop a deeper understanding of the subject.
